messages:
Anya: Quick thread — we need a concise benchmark narrative for the webinar. Focus: how prefix/KV caching + batching reduces token cost for chat apps. Need one hero chart, two snack cards, and a 3-slide demo flow. Target: product folks and infra leads. Can we lock copy and viz by EOD Thurs?
Jon VZ: Love that. For the hero chart I propose 'tokens served vs cost' with lines for no-cache / small-cache / large-cache. x-axis = avg prompt length, y-axis = $/1k output tokens. Keep colors high-contrast for slides.
Priya P: Wording idea: 'Same model, smarter serving — 2–5x savings at common prompt lengths' — keeps it tangible. Avoid heavy math on the hero slide; save details for an appendix.
Diego (Eng): I can surface real telemetry from Dedicated test pool. Will run queries for avg prefix hit rate by prompt length and overall per-token CPU/GPU cycles. ETA: tomorrow morning.
Nora (Growth): Webinar CTA: 'Estimate your token savings' — link to cost calculator. We should A/B test CTAs: calc vs demo signup. Also want a 1-line social hook we can run as paid creative.
Jon VZ: Sample axis labels / sketch idea:

``
x: Avg prompt length (tokens) — 50 to 2,000
y: $ per 1k output tokens
series: no-cache | prefix-cache (32KB) | prefix-cache (128KB)
``

I can mock three variants: clean line chart, small-multiples by workload, and a stacked-area showing savings share. Will aim to share PNG by noon tomorrow.
Anya: Also need one quick excerpt for the launch post & social: 2 short bullets + one chart GIF. First line option: 'Cut inference bills — not capabilities.' Keep voice punchy.
Priya P: I'll draft 3 copy variants: Option A (benefit-first), Option B (tech-first), Option C (ROI-first). Posting drafts here for picks.
Diego (Eng): FYI from an internal run: 128KB prefix cache reduced per-token decode cost by ~45% on a multi-turn convo workload with high reuse. Will attach raw numbers.
benchmark-bot: new telemetry export uploaded: s3://redwood-infer/bench/prefix-cache/1711102500.csv :thumbsup:
Anya: Great — next steps checklist: Diego = telemetry + CSV, Jon = hero chart mock + 2 snack cards, Priya = copy variants, Nora = CTA funnel + cost-calc hook. Check-in tomorrow 10:00am PT.
Jon VZ: Noted — pushing initial PNG to the deck by 9:30am.
Priya P: Will post copy drafts here when ready.
Nora (Growth): I'll prep a landing fragment and short reg flow (calc + demo choice). Also can wire basic UTM parameters for paid channels.
Anya: Thanks team :rocket: Let's keep the hero chart simple and the CTA crystal clear. If anyone hits blocking data issues ping me directly.
